nom: Pacifica Bacne Warrior - Bacne Salicylic Acid Spray

concerns.blemishes: The overwhelming majority of reviewers report clear improvement in back, chest, or body acne within days to a few weeks, including some who use it as a facial spot treatment for hormonal breakouts or ingrown-hair bumps; one reviewer, however, reports it gave her a rash instead and did nothing for her acne.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers who had previously been dried out or cracked by other salicylic acid body washes report this one doesn't have that effect; one reviewer, however, notes skin can get dry and recommends moisturizing heavily alongside it.
concerns.redness: One reviewer, who says she doesn't have particularly sensitive skin and has used many products on her chest before, reports the spray gave her a sunburn-type rash across her chest.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports her acne mostly cleared within two weeks but that some dark marks and a few remaining pimples were still present.

aspects.libelle: Sprayer can jam or run out

extraits.texte: The smell wasn’t bad for me and it liked how easy it was to apply. I don’t have super sensitive skin and have used all sorts of products on my chest but this product has given me a sunburn type rash all over my chest. I’m giving it 2 stars bc it could be a really cool product but just didn’t work on my skin.

I bought this product by accident but decided to keep it because I battle acne on my chest every fall and winter. The product itself gets 5 stars. If used early, it cleared up any break-outs overnight! Truly amazing. The packaging, however, ZERO stars. The spray mechanism was so hard to push down and control that I had to spray it into my other hand, and then rub it where I wanted it. Now, after only a few uses, it down doesn't work at all, so I am going to have to throw out 90% or the product. Very disappointing, and i hope the manufacturer reads these reviews and fixes their design.

extraits.titre: Yes yes, you should buy this
extraits.texte: I’d give this 500 stars if I could. Where has this been my whole life? I’ve had body acne since adolescence, and the only thing it’s ever responded to is prescription creams (which are expensive for how much coverage you need and also difficult to apply to oneself.) I’ve tried salicylic acid based body washes before, but they just end up drying out my skin until I have to discontinue them (and the body acne comes back) or I have to use so much moisturizer that the acne doesn’t go away. But this stuff? Downright magic. I towel dry after a shower, step back into the shower, and quickly spray myself with ease. My skin has improved so much without cracking or drying out. I wish I had a Time Machine to take a case of this stuff to my high school self. (A heads up, this stuff is very unpleasant to breathe in. I hold my breath during application in the shower, and then immediately step out of the shower stall before I breathe again.)

I rarely write reviews but felt the need for this one. I just repurchased on sale because it was working amazingly for butt acne... And I've also been using it on my bikini area for ingrown and it has worked so well compared to everything else I've tried over the years for those areas. I was inspired to write the review because I finally put some on a facial area where I've been having hormonal acne that hasn't seemed to go away for the past few months. I think it started out as hormonal acne and then maybe turn into tiny ingrown hair bumps from plucking too often or messing with that area and I finally got inspired to put some of this on an exfoliating cotton pad last night. And I woke up and the bumps were gone! This stuff is magic. I wouldn't recommend putting it all over your face but only using it as a spot treatment from time to time. And this spray is so convenient for the back area. Add to that, it smells amazing. I paid way more money the first time and I was about to be grudgingly shell out more and was so pleasantly surprised to find it on sale. Buy this! It's a worthy investment that you won't regret.

I have been struggling with acne for years. I use salicylic acid body wash but that wasn’t cutting it, I needed to add a spray. I used a different brands spray but it was over priced and hard to reach my back. This spray has been so helpful in keeping back breakouts away for a fraction of the cost. The can also makes it super easy to spray on your back and tough to reach spots. Make sure you do this in a ventilated space though because if you spray and inhale any of it then it will make you cough.

Great! This helped me so much with ny acne break out on the back. It will hurt a but at first, but it gets mire comfortable once your bigger pimples clear. Use this with an antibacterial soap. Skin can get dry so moisturize a lot. Cover your nose with you spray it. Very effective!
